dialogues.speaker: Demyan
dialogues.text: Hmm... Ever since the Fatui set up their experimental design bureau on Paha Isle, the atmosphere around the place has changed a lot. Some say it's because they're battling the Wild Hunt, but who knows for certain?

dialogues.speaker: Demyan
dialogues.text: Some dislike the way they throw their weight around, but others are eager to get their mitts on their new technology.

dialogues.speaker: Demyan
dialogues.text: But the Frostmoon Scions' view of them has remained constant... Thinking back on what the Fatui have done to those statues, it's not hard to see why. If you ask me, they'll come to blows sooner rather than later.
